answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 7107 Country: MU Title: Is it permissible to give poor and needy person food as isaale sawaab after the death of a muslim? Question: Is it permissible to give poor and needy person food as isaale sawaab after the death of a muslim? Answer ID: 7107 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 795/795=M/1429) Yes, it is permissible. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
